text:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up — I'm pushing a change to ratecard metadata in staging tomorrow that adds tag fields and an explicit `deprecated_since` attribute. This will change how discounts show up in DealDesk. Need alignment on approval paths & override windows.
ben_dealdesk: Thanks. Does this affect commit crediting for existing SKUs or just new ratecard entries?
mar ia_sales: just metadata + visibility for now — no price deltas. commit-crediting logic stays on v2 until we flip. We'll keep a compat lookup.
jules_revops: Proposal: add `rc_tag` (e.g. "rc_v3"), `deprecated_since` (date), and `grandfathered` boolean. Migration window = 60 days. After that, UI hides deprecated SKUs unless `grandfathered=true`.
oliver_pricing: +1 on the fields. One ask: any discount >20% must go through DealDesk + Legal + Finance approval. Can we encode required approvers in metadata like `approval_level: dealdesk+legal`?
maria_sales: yes, we can add `approval_level`. For manual overrides I want a clear audit trail. Ben — how do you want exceptions surfaced?
ben_dealdesk: Prefer a `dealdesk_exception` flag with `exception_ticket` link (Jira). If set, DealDesk UI shows an "Exception" banner and a link to the ticket. Also: who signs for multi-year commits?
jules_revops: Signer rules: 
- <20% discount = AE sign-off
- 20–50% = AE + DealDesk admin
- >50% or non-standard terms = Legal + Finance + CRO
Make this a mapping in the ratecard metadata: `signer_matrix` with thresholds.
athena_ops: FYI deploy constraints: staging deploy window tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC (2h). Production deploy tentatively Friday 03:00–05:00 UTC. If we need extra time for the migration script, we should schedule a hotfix window.
maria_sales: Good catch. We'll run the migration in staging first and smoke test DealDesk flows: commit creation, exception flow, and POC quoting.
ben_dealdesk: If we flip the UI to hide deprecated SKUs after 60 days, what happens to open POCs quoting that SKU? Need auto-fallback. Suggest: if quote references deprecated SKU, UI warns and suggests `compatible_skus` list.
jules_revops: Agreed — include `compatible_skus` array in metadata. Also include `fallback_policy: keep|migrate|block` (default: keep for open quotes).
oliver_pricing: Also add `effective_date` and `sunset_notice` fields so sales reps can proactively inform customers.
ratecard-bot: Ratecard draft created: id=rc_v3_1998765432, branch=metadata/tags, authored_by=maria_sales
maria_sales: Example snippet for the new metadata (staging):
```json
{
  "sku": "redwood-gen-8k",
  "rc_tag": "rc_v3",
  "approval_level": "dealdesk+legal",
  "deprecated_since": "2026-04-15",
  "grandfathered": false,
  "compatible_skus": ["redwood-gen-4k"],
  "fallback_policy": "keep"
}
```
ben_dealdesk: That looks good. One operational ask: add a `deprecation_notice_days` integer so we can surface a countdown in the UI (eg 14 days left).
jules_revops: I'll add `deprecation_notice_days` and update the migration checklist. I'll also add a short runbook for DealDesk: how to approve exceptions and which fields to fill (exception_ticket, approver_emails, signer_matrix entry).
athena_ops: Ops checklist: backup ratecard table before migration, run migration in staging, smoke test with sample POCs, monitor error budget in the deploy window (we have 15m SLO error budget for ratecard service).
maria_sales: Plan for rollout:
- Wed 02:00–04:00 UTC: push metadata fields to staging + run migration script (staging branch)
- Thu: QA + DealDesk smoke tests (handle any exception flows)
- Fri 03:00–05:00 UTC: production deploy (v3 metadata), flip UI to show rc_v3 tags but keep v2 as default until we confirm no regressions
- +60 days: hide deprecated SKUs unless grandfathered
ben_dealdesk: OK. Can we get a short Slack message template for reps to notify customers when an SKU is deprecated? I'll craft the edu template once we finalize fields.
maria_sales: I'll post template after we finalize the metadata keys. For now, please ack if you need any changes.
oliver_pricing: Ack. Need a decision on the 20% threshold wording (inclusive of 20?). I prefer ">=20%" as the trigger.
jules_revops: Noted: `>=20%` equals DealDesk+Legal. I'll update docs.
ben_dealdesk: Ack from DealDesk side. I'll prep the exception workflow & Jira template.
maria_sales: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, ping me. :thumbsup:
